name: rtTimebaseLastLocalTime
evidence: core.data word, 0 in retail; rt_timebase_get_globaltime stores the latest rt_time_get_local value; rt_timebase_restart clears it

name: rtTimebaseGlobalTime
evidence: core.data word, 0 in retail; advanced by local-time deltas in rt_timebase_get_globaltime, set by rt_timebase_reset_globaltime

name: rtTimebaseStarted
evidence: core.data word, 0 in retail; set to 1 by rt_timebase_start, tested by update_globaltime

name: rtTimebaseQueryInterval
evidence: core.data word, 3000 in retail; rt_timebase_is_query_ready compares elapsed milliseconds against it

name: rtTimebaseDelays
evidence: core.bss 0x198 bytes; 100 delay words, count at 0x190, index at 0x194 (restart/start memset 0x198, update and percentile index it)

name: rtTimebaseQueryTimer
evidence: core.bss 8 bytes directly after rtTimebaseDelays; rt_time_start/rt_time_platform_fast_elapsed_msecs timer, cleared by restart

name: rtTimeInitialized
evidence: core.data byte, 0 in retail; rt_time_initialize sets it to 1 after capturing rtTimeBaseStamp, rt_time_get_base_diff tests it

name: rtTimeBaseStamp
evidence: core.bss RT_TIME_STAMP; rt_time_initialize captures it, rt_time_get_base_diff measures elapsed time from it

name: gMT
evidence: core.data RT_MT (0x9C8): 625 state words, index at 0x9C4; seedMT/reloadMT/randomMT address both from this base

name: rtMtMixA
evidence: core.data word after gMT; randomMT output mixer, rotated right by 7 and xored with the state word

name: rtMtMixB
evidence: core.data word; randomMT output mixer, xored with the state word rotated left by 7

name: mediusMtLastOutput
evidence: core.data word (debug-info name y); last randomMT result, fed back into the next call

name: rtTimePlatformInitialized
evidence: core.data byte after rtTimeInitialized; set by rt_time_platform_init, tested by update_base

name: rtTimePlatformBase
evidence: core.bss RT_TIME_PLATFORM_BASE {Secs, Ticks, USecs, LastCount}; COP0 Count time base kept by update_base

name: rtTimePlatformDate
evidence: core.bss RT_TIME_DATE; decoded from the CD RTC by update_date_time, read by get_date_time

name: rtTimeCdromDevice
evidence: core.data string "cdrom0:" passed to sceDevctl by update_date_time

name: rtCryptMd5Padding
evidence: core.data 64-byte RFC 1321 PADDING (0x80 then zeros); md5Final pads with it

name: rtCryptMd2Padding
evidence: core.data RFC 1319 PADDING pointer table indexed by pad length; md2Final

name: rtCryptMd2Sbox
evidence: core.data rodata RFC 1319 PI_SUBST (debug-info name gS); md2Transform

name: rtCryptShaInitState
evidence: core.data SHA_CTX (0x60) with the SHA-1 initial digest; SHAInit copies it whole

name: rtCryptShaEndianProbe
evidence: core.data rodata string "#S" read as an unsigned short by endianTest

name: rtCryptMd4Padding
evidence: core.data 64-byte RFC 1320 PADDING (0x80 then zeros); md4Final pads with it

name: rtCryptVersionString
evidence: core.data rodata string "rt_crypt version: 2.10.2"; returned by KM_GetVersionStringPtr

name: rtCryptPrngSeeded
evidence: core.data byte; InitializePRNG seeds the Mersenne Twister once and sets it

name: mediusACodecGSMInterfacePtr
evidence: core.data pointer between gUDPInterfacePtr and gACodecLPCInterfacePtr; no debug-info name; CreateCodec uses it for 320-byte frames encoded to 33 bytes (GSM 06.10)

name: mediusMessageIdFormat
evidence: core.data rodata string "%s.%d"; iCreateAndAllocateMessageID formats session key and counter

name: rtParseInitialized
evidence: core.data byte; set by rt_parse_initialize, cleared by rt_parse_shutdown, tested by every rt_parse entry point

name: rtParseFragmentId
evidence: core.data byte; zeroed after rt_parse_initialize registers the fragment handler

name: rtParseMessageBuffer
evidence: core.data pointer; MaxMessageSize*3-byte buffer each message payload is copied into before its parser runs

name: rtParseParsers
evidence: core.data pointer; parser callbacks indexed [class * rtParseMaxTypes + type]

name: gaTypeCount
evidence: core.data pointer (debug-info name); registered type count per message class

name: rtParseMessageCounts
evidence: core.data pointer; per-type receive counters incremented by rt_parse_execute

name: rtParsePreExecuteCallback
evidence: core.data pointer; optional callback rt_parse_execute runs before each parser

name: rtParseMaxTypes
evidence: core.bss word; MaxTypes passed to rt_parse_initialize

name: rtParseMaxClasses
evidence: core.bss word; MaxClasses passed to rt_parse_initialize

name: rtParseMaxMessageSize
evidence: core.bss word; MaxMessageSize passed to rt_parse_initialize

name: rtParseFragments
evidence: core.bss pointer; 256 fragment-reassembly slots of 0x34 bytes, buffer pointer at +0x30

name: mediusBillingEnabled
evidence: core.data word, no debug-info name; MediusAccountDelete returns MediusErrorFeatureNotEnabled and MediusAccountLogout takes the billing path when it is 1

name: mediusBillingState
evidence: core.data word, no debug-info name; MediusBillingAccountLogout sets it to 3 to request a logout

name: mediusBillingServerVersion
evidence: core.data char array, no debug-info name; server library version string copied out by MediusBillingServerVersion

name: mediusBillingLogoutEcho
evidence: core.data word, no debug-info name; user argument for the billing logout callback

name: mediusBillingLogoutCallback
evidence: core.data word, no debug-info name; billing logout completion callback set by MediusBillingAccountLogout

name: mediusBillingLoaded
evidence: core.bss word, no debug-info name; non-zero once the billing library is loaded (MediusBillingUpdate, MediusBillingIsLoaded)

name: mediusBillingLogoutRequest
evidence: core.bss MediusAccountLogoutRequest (0x26), no debug-info name; copy of the last logout request, resent by MediusAccountLogoutInternal
